subject: A compact farm gun tower: tall cross-braced timber legs on a small stone footing, a small metal turntable and one clearly visible long horizontal gun barrel pointing upper-right. No operator, roof or enclosed cabin.
levels: simple timber trestle with one modest iron gun barrel
stronger diagonal timber braces, iron corner straps and a visibly heavier gun receiver
compact reinforced stone/iron lower pedestal, stronger mechanical turntable and two parallel gun barrels; a different construction and weapon silhouette, not stacked posts

subject: A compact farm flamethrower tower: squat reinforced timber support, one conspicuous copper fuel tank, a clearly joined curved dark-metal pipe and short wide nozzle pointing upper-right. Idle nozzle is dark; no permanent flame.
levels: single rounded copper tank, simple pipe and short dark nozzle on timber supports
iron-strapped copper tank, thicker visible supply pipe and reinforced nozzle mount
armored copper fuel housing, strong metal pump mechanism and a wider heavy burner nozzle on stone/iron footing

subject: A LOW, squat farm mortar: a broad small stone/timber base with a short heavy dark-metal tube tilted steeply upward toward upper-right and a clearly open round barrel mouth. It sits near the ground, not on a lookout tower.
levels: simple broad timber carriage and one short thick upward-tilted tube
iron-strapped carriage, visible elevation wheel and heavier banded tube
compact stone/iron carriage, large elevation mechanism and broad armored mortar tube with reinforced collar; remain visibly low

subject: An automatic farm crossbow on a timber stand: very obvious broad wooden bow limbs, taut string, central metal bolt rail aimed upper-right and a visible small mechanical loading gear. It must read as a bow, never a gun or a roofed building.
levels: simple timber stand, single broad wooden bow and visible bolt rail
iron-strapped braced stand, heavier bow limbs and conspicuous geared bolt feeder
reinforced compact stone/iron footing, broad laminated bow limbs and large gear-driven automatic bolt magazine; a stronger distinct bow mechanism
